metadata.title: Geography of Klein bottle Luttinger surgery
metadata.abstract: We propose and study a modification of Auroux's uniqueness question on Luttinger surgery by replacing Lagrangian tori with Klein bottles. In Kodaira dimension $-\infty$, we introduce two simple graphs whose connected components give bounds and, in several cases, exact counts of Klein bottle Luttinger equivalence classes. In Kodaira dimension zero, we provide examples of numerical invariants supporting infinitely many equivalence classes and prove a homological non-triviality theorem for Lagrangian Klein bottles in all symplectic Calabi--Yau surfaces with positive Euler characteristic. In positive Kodaira dimensions, we construct examples in which Klein bottle Luttinger surgery changes the symplectic Kodaira dimension.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Klein 瓶 Luttinger 手术的辛地理
analysis.workSummary: 将 Lagrangian 环面的 Luttinger 等价问题改成 Klein 瓶版本。在 Kodaira 维数 −∞ 时以两个简单图的连通分支界定并在若干情形精确计算等价类数目。
techniques: 图连通分支与同调障碍
analysis.breakthrough: 零 Kodaira 维数时给支持无穷多等价类的数值不变量例，并在 Euler 特征数正的辛 Calabi–Yau 曲面证明 Klein 瓶同调非平凡。正 Kodaira 情形构造会改变辛 Kodaira 维数的手术。
analysis.limitations: 不同 Kodaira 维数对应不同结论，精确计数只在文中若干情形成立。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 AI 发现第1.1节例子并澄清附录A两种手术关系，促成项目。Klein 瓶版本的问题受到文献[AE26]启发。LLM 还指出 Remark3.5、提示[KT90]等文献并推动第6节改变 Kodaira 维数的构造（参 Remark6.4），以及语言和图示修订。按具体例子和构造归因记 ideas，另记 literature、writing。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.23681v1 · PDF 第6页 AI disclosure；第36页 Remark6.4
